# @mission-platform/vite-plugin-assemblyscript

A Vite plugin that compiles an AssemblyScript (https://www.assemblyscript.org/)
entry to WebAssembly and emits a single self-contained ES module with the wasm
binary inlined as base64. Consuming packages then import a dependency-free
module with no `.wasm` URL resolution (works in browsers and Web Workers).

Compilation runs the AssemblyScript compiler (`asc`) programmatically in the
rollup `buildStart` hook, so the module is produced during `vite build`,
`vite build --watch`, and dev-server start alike — making `vite build` the
single entry point for building AssemblyScript.

## Entry point

- `.` → the plugin factory plus reusable helpers.

## Exports

- `assemblyScriptPlugin(options): Plugin` — default export and named export.
- `compileAssemblyScript(options): Promise<void>` — the underlying compile +
  codegen step (usable outside Vite).
- `extractInstantiate(bindingsSource): string` — strips the URL auto-instantiation
  from `asc` ESM bindings, keeping only the `instantiate()` function.
- `buildGeneratedModule(wasmBase64, instantiateSource): string` — builds the
  self-contained module text (base64 wasm + memoised `loadModule()`).
- Types: `AssemblyScriptPluginOptions`, `AssemblyScriptCompileOptions`.

## Options (AssemblyScriptCompileOptions)

- `entry: string` — AssemblyScript entry `.ts`, relative to `rootDir`.
- `outFile: string` — generated self-contained ES module to emit.
- `wasmFile?: string` — intermediate `.wasm` path (default `build/module.wasm`).
- `rootDir?: string` — base dir for relative paths (default `process.cwd()`).
- `optimizeLevel?: number` — `asc` optimize level (default `3`).
- `shrinkLevel?: number` — `asc` shrink level (default `1`).
- `emitText?: boolean` — also emit `.wat` (default `false`).

## Generated module

```ts
import { loadModule } from './generated/module.js';

const wasm = await loadModule(); // memoised; returns the raw AssemblyScript exports
```

Provide a hand-maintained `.d.ts` next to the generated `.js` to type the raw
exports — the plugin only writes the `.js`.

## Example

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { assemblyScriptPlugin } from '@mission-platform/vite-plugin-assemblyscript';
import { defineLibraryConfig } from '@mission-platform/vite-config';

export default defineLibraryConfig({
  rootDir: __dirname,
  entry: { index: 'src/index.ts' },
  preserveModules: false,
  overrides: {
    plugins: [
      assemblyScriptPlugin({
        rootDir: __dirname,
        entry: 'assembly/index.ts',
        wasmFile: 'build/module.wasm',
        outFile: 'src/generated/module.js',
      }),
    ],
  },
});
```

Used by `@mission-platform/phone-number` to build its libphonenumber port.
